Track a project deadline with milestones — progress percentage, days left and a checkable milestone list saved in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the project name and its deadline.
  2. Add milestones with a name and target date each.
  3. Tick milestones off as you complete them.
  4. Progress, days left and the checklist update and save automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is my project saved?

Yes — your project, deadline and milestone checkmarks are saved in this browser's localStorage and restored on your next visit.

How are progress and days-left calculated?

Progress is the share of milestones marked done. Days left counts down to the deadline from today.

How do I delete a milestone?

Use the ✕ button on a milestone row. To start over, clear the project name and deadline and re-save.
